# MEL ONE

> MEL ONE provides Adelaide carpentry, custom joinery, decking, cabinetry and heritage timber restoration. Request a clear quote from one local team. English and 简体中文 content is available below.

## English services
- [Carpentry & Joinery Services Adelaide](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/): Choose a timber repair, fitted joinery, outdoor work or construction service.
- [Timber Door & Window Repairs Adelaide](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/door-window-repairs/): We repair existing timber doors and windows in Adelaide.
- [Timber Rot Repairs Adelaide — Restoration & Maintenance](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/restoration-maintenance/): We assess accessible timber damage and compare local repair, splicing and component replacement.
- [Built-in Wardrobes Adelaide — Custom Storage & Shelving](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/storage-solutions/): We plan built-in wardrobes, bookcases and study storage around what you need to store and how you use the room.
- [Kitchen & Bathroom Cabinetry Adelaide — Custom Joinery](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/custom-kitchen-bathroom/): We plan and install kitchen cabinets, vanity joinery and laundry storage around your room, appliances and selected finishes.
- [Outdoor Carpentry Adelaide — Decks, Pergolas & Timber Screens](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/outdoor-living/): We plan new timber decks, pergolas and privacy screens around how you use the outdoor space.
- [Deck Restoration & Timber Floor Repairs Adelaide](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/decking-restoration-flooring/): We repair and refinish existing decks and carry out separately scoped indoor timber-floor work.
- [Heritage Carpenter Adelaide — Timber Repairs & Restoration](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/heritage-carpentry/): We assess heritage timber with retention as the starting point, comparing local repair, profile matching and replacement where needed.
- [Framing Carpenter Adelaide — House Framing](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/house-framing/): We install timber wall, roof and floor framing to the project drawings.
- [Commercial Carpenter Adelaide — Fitout & Refurbishment](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/fitout-refurbishment/): We install and repair timber partitions, counters, displays and feature finishes in offices, shops and hospitality premises.
